title.narrative: Mine Action Technical Support Services to MINUSCA in Central African Republic

description.narrative:
Established in 1997, the United Nations Mine Action Service (UNMAS) leads, coordinates, and implements projects and programmes to mitigate the threats posed by explosive ordnance to the benefit of millions of people worldwide.

UNMAS in the Central African Republic contributes to the explosive ordnance threat mitigation and response efforts and continues to reinforce the capacity of the national authorities in weapons and ammunition management (WAM) in line with the MINUSCA’s strategic objectives.
